runs.report:
Yes, the town is visible.

What I opened: I ran system Chrome headless (1440x900, virtual-time-budget=8000) on `https://sprag.io/team/?demo=1&lang=ko`. The screenshot is `<scratch>/…` (PNG, 1440 x 900, 352,843 bytes). I read the image directly. The only other output was unrelated Chrome noise (allocator warning, GCM DEPRECATED_ENDPOINT). I did not need the second URL (`&view=town`), so I did not try it.

What is shown: the top nav has the "타운" tab highlighted, next to 좌석, 팀, 규칙 and 프롬프트. Under it is a demo banner saying no real data is saved. The main panel, titled "Northwind Labs Sprag 타운 · 10.9–11.7", holds a rendered 3D isometric office with four colored zones labeled Apps, Platform, Data and 빈 좌석 4개. Animal characters (cat, fox, tiger and others) sit at desks with monitors, and there are plants and a tooltip reading "Sprag 서버 · 전체 사용량 $1,134 · 절감 $322". At the bottom of the panel is an animal-collection legend ("동물 도감 16/30종") and a row of KPI cards (spend $2,033.62, savings $965.16, delegation runs 8,943, and so on). The panel was not blank, loading or showing an error.

Could not verify: this is a single static frame taken after 8s of virtual time. I did not check interactivity (rotate, zoom, fullscreen), animation or the other tabs. I did not check the console for errors, and I did not check the page without `lang=ko`.
